scenarios.label: Tenant
scenarios.summary: An occupier seeks a bill-name change without owning the property.

scenarios.label: Previous consumer deceased
scenarios.summary: The recorded consumer has died and a successor seeks transfer.

scenarios.label: Consent unavailable
scenarios.summary: The previous consumer cannot or will not provide consent.

sources.title: Conditions of Supply of Electricity with I and II Amendments
sources.notes: Current BESCOM-hosted PDF directly inspected. Clause 36 and Annex 9 contain the transfer text used here. The PDF visibly carries 2013 page dates and refers to earlier amendment notifications; this pass did not locate a current KERC confirmation that Clause 36 remains the applicable exception checklist. Treat the content as official but potentially outdated.

sources.title: BESCOM Frequently Asked Questions — How To Change Name?
sources.notes: Current public FAQ directly inspected. It describes customer login, Janasnehi Vidhyuth Sevegalu, Name Change/Change of Ownership, preferred account selection, mandatory fields, document upload, submission, request ID, and payment. No login or case-specific exception validation was attempted.

sources.title: Track Name Change
sources.notes: Current public page directly inspected. It exposes a Request ID (Enter from SMS) field and Submit control, with 1912 help. No request ID was entered.

claims.text: The BESCOM-hosted Conditions PDF says that the registered consumer furnishes a consent letter to transfer the installation and deposits to the transferee.
claims.notes: This records wording in the currently hosted but visibly older Conditions PDF. It does not establish a current authenticated consent field or acceptance decision.

claims.text: The BESCOM-hosted Conditions PDF says that, in the absence of the registered consumer's consent letter, the transferee may produce ownership evidence including a registered sale deed, partition deed, khata, succession or heirship certificate, or deed of last will.
claims.notes: The listed succession/heirship and will options are evidence leads for the deceased-consumer route, not proof that any supplied document will be accepted now.

claims.text: The BESCOM-hosted Conditions PDF says that, where consent is absent, occupancy proof such as a valid power of attorney, latest rent-paid receipt, or valid lease deed is limited to non-commercial lighting and non-commercial combined lighting-and-heating installations.
claims.notes: This is not a general tenant entitlement or a current acceptance checklist; the tariff/category and current applicability remain unverified.

claims.text: The BESCOM-hosted Conditions PDF says that the transferee executes an Annex 9 indemnity bond for disputes arising from the transfer.
claims.notes: Annex 9 is present in the hosted PDF. No current BESCOM submission route or acceptance of an indemnity bond was observed.

claims.text: The BESCOM-hosted Conditions PDF says that no arrears may be outstanding against an installation for transfer.
claims.notes: No account balance or arrears outcome was queried.

claims.text: The BESCOM-hosted Conditions PDF says that the transferee executes a fresh power-supply agreement with the licensee for transfer.
claims.notes: No agreement form, current signature process, or completed agreement was inspected.

claims.text: The BESCOM-hosted Conditions PDF says that, where the registered consumer has not consented to transfer of the deposit, the transferee pays a fresh deposit as a new consumer.
claims.notes: No deposit calculation, demand, or payment was observed; do not state an amount.

claims.text: BESCOM's current public FAQ describes an authenticated Name Change/Change of Ownership route with account selection, mandatory fields, document upload, submission, request ID, and payment.
claims.notes: This confirms only the public generic route, not the acceptance of any exception evidence.

claims.text: This pass did not establish a current public BESCOM rule for acceptance of tenant occupancy evidence, deceased-consumer succession evidence, or a no-consent transfer packet in the authenticated Name Change route.
claims.notes: The public FAQ was inspected without login and the current hosted Conditions PDF has unresolved applicability. No account-specific validation or submission was attempted.

claims.text: BESCOM's current public Track Name Change page requests the Request ID sent by SMS and provides a Submit control.
claims.notes: No request ID was entered, so this does not establish a status result or exception-route completion.

nodes.label: Exception transfer evidence
nodes.summary: Officially hosted historic transfer wording provides conditional consent, ownership/succession, and narrowly scoped occupancy evidence leads; current acceptance remains unknown.
nodes.requiredState: Confirm the current exception-specific document rule and applicable tariff/category before preparing or submitting any evidence.

checks.label: Historic ownership or succession evidence lead
checks.description: The hosted Conditions PDF lists ownership evidence, including succession/heirship certificate and deed of last will, when consent is absent.

checks.label: Historic tenant occupancy-evidence lead
checks.description: The hosted Conditions PDF limits its no-consent occupancy examples to stated non-commercial installation classes.

failureSignals.label: Consent is unavailable
failureSignals.description: The hosted Conditions wording supplies alternative evidence categories only when the registered consumer's consent letter is absent; current portal acceptance is not established.

failureSignals.label: Tenant category is not confirmed
failureSignals.description: The public historical occupancy wording is limited by installation class and does not establish tenant eligibility for a particular account.

recoveries.label: Obtain a current exception checklist
recoveries.description: Use the hosted ownership/succession or scoped occupancy text only as a lead; obtain current written confirmation from BESCOM of the accepted evidence packet before submitting.

nodes.label: Transfer obligations
nodes.summary: The hosted historic Conditions text identifies indemnity, arrears, fresh agreement, and deposit consequences; no live exception calculation or acceptance was observed.
nodes.requiredState: Confirm current applicability, account arrears, demand, agreement, and deposit treatment through an authorised BESCOM channel.

checks.label: Historic transfer indemnity lead
checks.description: The hosted Conditions PDF calls for an Annex 9 indemnity bond for transfer disputes.

checks.label: Historic fresh-agreement lead
checks.description: The hosted Conditions PDF says the transferee executes a fresh power-supply agreement.

failureSignals.label: Arrears state is unresolved
failureSignals.description: The hosted Conditions text says no arrears may be outstanding, but no account was queried in this pass.

failureSignals.label: No-consent deposit treatment is unpriced
failureSignals.description: The hosted Conditions text describes a fresh deposit without consent for deposit transfer; no live amount or demand was observed.

recoveries.label: Request current obligation confirmation
recoveries.description: Before any authorised submission, ask BESCOM to state the current exception-route requirements for arrears, indemnity, fresh agreement, and deposit treatment in writing.

nodes.label: BESCOM name transfer
nodes.summary: The current public entry describes a generic authenticated name-change route, but no exception-specific document acceptance was observed.
nodes.requiredState: A current authorised decision is needed on whether the exception evidence can be submitted and accepted through the authenticated route.

nodes.label: Request tracking

nodes.requiredState: Retain an SMS Request ID after an authorised submission; no exception-case tracker result was inspected.

roadblocks.title: Current exception checklist is not publicly established
roadblocks.symptom: Public BESCOM material exposes a generic authenticated name-change route while the hosted exception Conditions text has unresolved current applicability.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Tenant, succession, consent, tariff/category, arrears, deposit, and account facts require case-specific BESCOM validation not visible in this pass.
roadblocks.recovery: Obtain current written BESCOM confirmation of the applicable exception evidence and obligations before providing documents or submitting a request.
